retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s action aesthetic featuring a central gritty protagonist against a deep red radial gradient with heavy slab-serif display type.
triggerTerms: gritty hero with aviators and laser sight

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a rugged male protagonist in tactical black clothing and blue-tinted aviators, positioned on the left, holding a weapon with a visible pink laser beam. The background is a dark, moody red radial gradient. The right side is dedicated to clean, heavy-weight typography organized in a clear hierarchy.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on left balanced by right-aligned text block
Pink laser beam providing a sharp diagonal contrast to the vertical subject
Blue lens reflections contrasting the dominant red background
Dark silhouette of the subject against a bright central red glow
coreInvariants: Deep red to black radial gradient background
High-contrast rim lighting on the subject
Heavy slab-serif display font for main titles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Protagonist occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, waist-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face of the protagonist, specifically the blue-tinted aviator sunglasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the laser sight, follows down to the face, then moves right to the large title text and down through the list.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated on the right side to allow for legible text placement.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds; low value in the subject's clothing to create a silhouette effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, black, blue, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display type must have thick, blocky serifs
Secondary text should be highly condensed and vertically elongated
Horizontal rules used to separate sections
characterSpecificRedesigns: Underlining used for primary title blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with condensed sans-serif for information density.

avoid: Serif fonts with high stroke contrast

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif impact of the main title.
Provides the necessary condensed verticality for the list text.
Alternative slab serif with similar geometric properties.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty 80s action hero in a black shirt and aviators on the left side of the frame. The background should be a dark red radial gradient glowing from the center. Include a thin pink laser line crossing the upper left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, right-aligned slab-serif title in the top right. Below it, add a list of names in a bold, black, condensed sans-serif font, also right-aligned, separated by a horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the background a deep red gradient?
Is the main title a heavy slab-serif?
Does the protagonist have blue-tinted sunglasses?

avoid: Clashing neon colors other than the accents

postGenerationChecks: Check for clear separation between the subject and the text.
Ensure the red gradient does not wash out the white text.
Verify the slab-serif font feels 'heavy' and 'blocky'.
Confirm the laser beam originates from a logical point on the weapon.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Left) + Red Gradient(Background) + Slab Serif(Right-Top) + Condensed List(Right-Bottom) = 80s Action Aesthetic
